# Carbon

Carbon is a minimal, opinionated theme with light and dark schemes inspired by IBM Carbon design. It uses clean typography, a simplified interface, and refined embed and reading layouts for focused editing and distraction-free reading.

![Carbon screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vhbelvadi/obsidian-carbon/HEAD/obsidian-screenshot-small.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Carbon"
    author: "vhbelvadi"
    repo:   "vhbelvadi/obsidian-carbon"
    slug:   "carbon"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/carbon"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/vhbelvadi/obsidian-carbon"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vhbelvadi/obsidian-carbon/HEAD/obsidian-screenshot-small.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a minimal, opinionated theme offering light and dark schemes inspired by IBM Carbon design. Use clean typography, simplified UI, and refined embed and reading layouts for focused editing and distraction-free reading."
}
```
